## About
Road Race Engineering started with Road Racing and Pro Rally cars, and EVOs and Eclipses are still our core business. We fix them, we build parts for them, and we race them, from rally stages to Pikes Peak.
Day to day, the shop handles everything from basic service to timing belts, clutches and turbo work. We also help keep stock street cars serviced and running well. Customers tell us they like getting straight advice without a pushy upsell.
You will find us on La Dana Ct in Santa Fe Springs, near the freeway interchange. Drivers come in from all over So Cal, and we are rated 4.6 from 58 Google reviews.

## Services
- Basic service, timing belts and clutches: Everything from basic service to timing belts and clutches on EVOs and Eclipses.
- Turbo and manifold swaps: Turbo and manifold work along with regular maintenance, as customers describe in their reviews.
- Chassis dyno: Cars go on our own Dynapack chassis dyno right here at the shop.
- EVO and Eclipse parts: Fuel, intake, exhaust, brake, engine, suspension and drivetrain parts for EVO X and Eclipse, available for pickup or shipping.
- Race car support: We prepare, race and support cars for rally, road racing, time attack, drag and drift.

## FAQ
Q: Can I come by outside the usual times?
A: Often, yes. Plan with us ahead of time and we can set up a later appointment for parts pickup or advice.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: If you want advice or need your car looked at, it is best to set up an appointment first. Quick parts pickups are easier, but check ahead to see if the parts are in stock.

Q: When is the best time to call?
A: Between noon and 6 pm California time, when we have the most people on the phones.

Q: Do you work on stock cars too?
A: Yes. We can help keep your stock street car serviced and running well.
